Before he crossed into Schryke territory, he heard a strange humming sound coming from the Northeast, in the direction of the Lake of the Gods. He turned to look and in the distance, flying only feet above the ground, were large metalic creatures with glowing eyes.

Unsure of their intent, he waited for them to near. As he hailed them, they simple avoided him, parting around him and flying past. There was a slight pause in their advance, and one trailing behind with an erratic flight pattern came right for him. Grabbing his torso and arms with its tentacles, it lifted him into the air.

While they flew, high above the canopy of the forest of the Roost, the creature attempted to constrain his limbs and wrap him in some kind of cloth.

Guay wrestled with this creature and, one by one, tore its tentacles from its sockets until the device was unable to hold him any longer. He came crashing down through the canopy, bringing with him debris from the trees and pieces of metal, eventually landing with a thud on the smooth wooden floorboards of the Central Market of the Roost.
